purpose: F10 row-group pipeline DES screen; no throughput claim, no production code, no GPU/service touched. Control reproduces the f1 74.667 s anchor; the two-group split is replayed through the real transition-window cache with two route observations/layer.

timing_model.note: Per-layer non-read compute = G_full + host_pre + host_post + miss_assign*c_assign; hit_assign*c_assign runs on the GPU during reads (hidden except on zero-miss layers). host_post calibrated once at c_assign=0.035 so mean non-read compute == C_LAYER. Head is inside VERIFY_S->C_LAYER (no separate head term). 206-cycle trace replayed with per-198-cycle rates, exactly as the f1 sim; TPS=1024/total.

round2.correction: The routed per-expert gather is M-invariant, but the gate (xf @ weight.T) and the shared expert are NOT invariant to the row batch size M on Metal (mtplx/models/deepseek_v41_moe.py combine_routed docstring L446-449; deepseek_v41.py _layer_major_moe): splitting M into row groups reassociates their fp32 reductions and can flip greedy argmax. The row-group lever is therefore ROUNDING-CLASS (tie-flip audit required), NOT bit-identical.
round2.note: Event-driven engine simulate2 (Round 1 simulate() untouched). Control reproduces 74.99 s and S0 fixed/fifo reproduces Round 1 to <0.05%. Every arm >= its analytic lower bound.

three_group.assumption: G_third = G_half = 1.5 ms (a third batch is even more launch-bound, so this UNDER-states 3-group GPU cost).

variants_skipped.half_step_B_lags: B.barrier(L) before A.finish(L) opens B's route on L before A's route on L closes -> >1 open decode route/layer; the runtime forbids it. Not simulated.
variants_skipped.three_group: Not a trivial generalisation: 3 groups touching layer L per iteration need >1 open route (same runtime limit) and an unmeasured G_third launch-bound cost. Skipped.
